title: 画像情報処理
subtitle: Image Processing
educationalGoal:
The objective of this course is to ensure students understand the basic methods used to process digital image data using computers.
Learning Objectives:
1. Students will understand fundamental image processing techniques.
2. Students will be able to make programs that process real digital images and video image data using programming language.
advice:
In this course, students will learn the fundamental digital image processing methods that input, output, and transform digital images. In addition, students will learn to make programs that process real digital images using various fundamental techniques. Lectures and exercises regarding the following items will be given. The outline of the class content is as follows:
(1) Basics of image processing
    History of image processing, light and color, image digitization, image conversion
(2) Fundamental real image processing
　　Image data input/output, image data enhancement, geometric transformation, smoothing/sharpening, Binarization
(3) Programming method to realize various fundamental image processing methods
    Students will learn the skills necessary to make application programs through the creation of works aimed at contributing to the AI information society.
books: Textbooks：ディジタル画像処理 改訂第二版[ＣＧ－ＡＲＴＳ協会],reference books：none,reserved books：none
requiredKnowledge: It is important to use textbooks for preparation and review. The scope of the exam is based primarily on materials presented in the class, so it is necessary to understand the class contents well. If students study the class contents in advance and ask questions on matters than need clarification in the class, they can proceed more efficiently. In image processing programming exercises, it is important for students to review and acquire the presented lessons well.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the basics of digital image processing.
Be able to make fundamental programs that process digital image data and video image data.
Be able to understand binary images, gray images, and color images and then display them.
Be able to understand and explain the manipulation of pixel values of image data, calculation between images.
Be able to understand and explain histograms, contour extraction, and edge extraction from image data.

In addition, students will learn to make programs that process real digital images using various fundamental techniques. Lectures and exercises regarding the following items will be given. The outline of the class content is as follows:
(1) Basics of image processing
    History of image processing, light and color, image digitization, image conversion
(2) Fundamental real image processing
　　Image data input/output, image data enhancement, geometric transformation, smoothing/sharpening, Binarization
(3) Programming method to realize various fundamental image processing methods
